name: Tapped Dowsing Widget
summary: A Tapped Dowsing Widget holds a water sample from a pool near Sandsorrow Watch in Tanaris. The Gadgetzan Water Company needs such surveys as the desert's wells grow scarce.

sections.title: A Desert Sample
sections.body: Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser sends you from Gadgetzan to test the pool near Sandsorrow Watch. The widget taps a sample for the Gadgetzan Water Company, which seeks free sources of water as nomads seize its wells. Yet the pool lies within sight of the trolls, and the survey brings a further danger from the desert.

faq.q: What is the Tapped Dowsing Widget?
faq.answer: It is an Untapped Dowsing Widget that has collected a water sample from the pool near Sandsorrow Watch in Tanaris.

faq.q: Where do I use the dowsing widget?
faq.answer: Use the Untapped Dowsing Widget at the pool near Sandsorrow Watch, west of Gadgetzan and south of Zul'Farrak.
Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan asks you to bring the Tapped Dowsing Widget back to him for the Gadgetzan Water Company.

faq.q: Why is the company surveying water?
faq.answer: The Gadgetzan Water Company seeks free water sources because nomads are seizing its wells.

faq.q: What danger is near the pool?
faq.answer: Reports speak of strange bug-creatures sucking water from the desert. Surveyors may also be in sight of the trolls around the pool.
